This inviting beach home is designed for unwinding and reconnecting with nature, offering a peaceful retreat for the whole family. With two luxurious master suites, a cozy queen room, and a whimsical bunk room for the kids (with three twin beds and a bonus full-sized bed), everyone has their own space to relax. Surrounded by lush live oaks and charming beach bungalows, Bluebird Beach provides access to a serene neighborhood pool and hot tub—a perfect spot to rest beneath the coastal oaks. Just a short stroll away, deeded beach access leads you to pristine sands and breathtaking sunsets over the Gulf. The nearby village areas of Alys and Rosemary Beach are within walking or biking distance, offering trendy cafés, unique shops, and opportunities to explore. Inside, the open ground floor is designed for comfort, featuring a gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances, beautiful oak floors, and sleek marble-look quartz countertops. The cozy living area and convenient laundry room add to the ease of your stay, while upstairs, additional bedrooms and bathrooms provide ample space for everyone to retreat. Escape to the third-floor master suite for complete privacy, where you’ll find an ensuite bath and a private balcony with sweeping Gulf views—perfect for peaceful sunset moments. The private back patio is nestled among trees, creating an intimate setting for al fresco dining and evening cookouts by the grill. Whether you’re strolling to the beach to savor the emerald waters or enjoying the serenity of the community pool, Bluebird Beach offers a tranquil getaway close to all the natural beauty and quiet charm of 30A. Please note: Golf carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined. SLEEPING ARRANGMENTS (10): - Master Bedroom: King sized bed, ensuite bathroom - Master Bedroom 2: Queen sized bed, ensuite bathroom with tub/shower combo - Guest bedroom: Queen sized bed, shared bathroom with tub/shower combo - Bunk Room: Twin over full bed and a twin over twin bunk bed, shared bath with tub/shower combo HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - The Cottages at Camp Creek are a quick stroll to the 18 mile Timpoochee Trail where you can walk, bike or jog to exploe the many communities along 30A - Neighborhood has beach access across the road - Close to Alys (1 mile) Rosemary (1.5 miles) and The big Chill (2 miles) FEATURES: - Gulf Views - Community Pool and Hot tub - Stone Patio with table for 6 - Gas Grill - Easy Beach AccessNeighborhoodBlue Bird Beach is located in the Cottages at Camp Creek, a charming coastal community near the best of 30A. The Timpoochee Trail offers scenic walking and biking, while nearby Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach provide upscale dining, boutique shopping, and picturesque architecture.TransitThe home is best accessed by car, but bike rentals are a popular way to explore 30A. The neighborhood prohibits golf carts in Seacrest Beach.AccessGuests have full access to the home, private balconies and community pool and hot tub.Notes— Pool and hot tub available for guest use, we are not in control of unexpected repairs. — Please keep in mind that if you plan to visit the beach, you are responsible for verifying public access regulations
